name: sb-context-fe
description: Everyday Claude Code plugins for frontend projects (Nuxt, Vue + Vite): project context, GitHub admin, health checks, and global style alignment.

plugins.name: sb-context-fe
plugins.description: Installs the whole sb-context-fe kit in one step: sb-core, sb-github, sb-health and sb-design.

plugins.name: sb-core
plugins.description: Core of sb-context-fe: project setup and the shared .sb-context/ folder (project settings), migration from sb-context-nuxt 0.x, onboarding.

plugins.name: sb-github
plugins.description: GitHub side of a project with the GitHub CLI: repo audit and settings, rulesets, labels, pull requests, release-please and PR title checks.

plugins.name: sb-health
plugins.description: Project health checks: build, lint, dependencies (with major-version migrations), README, SEO, and a full checkup.

plugins.name: sb-design
plugins.description: Global style of an app: normalizes it into a fixed four-file Tailwind 4 structure, migrates templates, and extracts style and UI from a Claude design.
